name: Soumitra Chakraborty
bio: Soumitra Chakraborty is a Solution Architect and a team member with the Innovation and Product Engineering - SAP (IPE - SAP) group for the ERP on Cloud unit of TCS Platform Solutions. He has more than 17 years of experience in manufacturing, hi-tech, utilities, retail and financial services domains along with proficiency in SAP on-premise and cloud applications space. He holds a bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Communication Engineering from Kalyani University.

name: Soumya Banerjee
designation: Research Lead, Marketing Transformation – Research team, TCS
bio: Soumya Banerjee presently leads the corporate marketing research and advisory team at TCS. Soumya has 17 years of cross-industry experience and manages research and advisory consulting engagements for energy, resources, and utilities, and healthcare and education across geographies, including APAC and ANZ, Japan, Latin America, the Middle East, and Africa. Soumya has a special interest in research, automation, analytics, and thought leadership and has filed four patents with multiple publications globally. He has been a speaker in multiple forums, including workshops, symposiums, webinars, and guest lectures.

name: Soumya Chatterjee
bio: Soumya Chatterjee is the Global Engineering Head for Product Management at TCS. With over two decades of IT experience in various product development and solutions creation activities, he spearheads product engineering and design to elevate and utilize digital roadmap, toolsets, framework, and solutions to drive value for TCS customers. In his earlier role as Global Engineering Head for Cloud Apps, Microservices & API, Soumya has helped deliver large, multi-disciplinary digital transformation initiatives for global clients across industries. He is focused on development of new offerings in the area of cloud transformation.

name: Sounak Dey
designation: Senior Scientist
bio: Sounak Dey is a Senior Scientist at TCS Research working on intelligent edge and neuromorphic systems. Sounak is an MCA from Birla Institute of Technology, Mesra. He is a member of ACM India, with multiple international publications and granted patents.

name: Sourav Sengupta
designation: Industry Advisor, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Sourav Sengupta is an industry advisor with TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He has over 24 years of experience across the agribusiness, food, paper, packaging, chemical, and process industries. He is an industry practitioner, providing advisory services for process industry firms in Asia Pacific, Europe, and the North America. His areas of expertise are customer experience, manufacturing, supply chain, sustainability, and digital transformation. Sourav holds a Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering and a Master’s in business administration from the University of Mumbai, India.

name: Sowmyanarayanan VJ
designation: Consulting Partner, Risk Management Practice, Banking, Financial Services, & Insurance Unit, TCS
bio: Sowmyanarayanan VJ (Sowmy) is a consulting partner with the banking and financial services unit of TCS, specializing in operational risk. A qualified engineer and management graduate, he has over 19 years of industry experience in banking, capital markets and management consulting, and has assisted several top tier global banks in finding solutions to operational failures, optimization, and prudential norms. He provides consulting services to manage operational risk, for banks embarking on transformational journeys.

name: Sowmya Mullur Rajagopalan
designation: VP and Head. Travel, Transportation and Hospitality, Americas, TCS
bio: Sowmya heads the Travel, Transportation and Hospitality Business Unit in Americas. She is responsible for Customer Relationship, Business Development & Growth, and Delivery Excellence. With 29 years of IT industry experience, Sowmya has managed multiple, large transformation engagements and has led one of the fastest growing units within TCS. She has played a pivotal role in building trusted and long-term relationships with TCS' customers. Her forte lies in her ability to develop and attract business' most vital resource- its people. Passionate about building 'One Team', Sowmya has organically created some of the most diverse and efficient teams in TCS that have consistently displayed the ability to take risks, think outside the box and fuel growth and transformation.

name: Sreeja R
designation: Automation and AI Architect, CMI Technology Solutions
bio: Sreeja is a solution architect specializing in the areas of service delivery transformation, including AIOps, Gen AI, Automation, DevSecOps and quality assurance. In the domain of communications and media, she is an expert in analyzing the industry trends and taking the latest technology solutions and concepts to the customers. Sreeja is an automation and AI expert and has been associated with the AIOps solutioning for the past five years. She has extensively worked as an industry analyst, change agent, and an AI advisor. She has experience in technical landscaping, process mining, and building AI-ML models and processes. She has built an TCS IP product, authored white papers, articles, and created point of views on latest technology including generative AI.

name: Sreenivasa Chakravarti
designation: Vice President and Global Head - Industrial Autonomy & Engineering
bio: Sreenivasa Chakravarti is vice president for the IoT and Digital Engineering business unit at TCS. He has 32 years of cross-functional experience, cutting across consulting and advisory services, and IT and manufacturing industry functions. He works on issues of significance to industrial enterprises, addressing the challenges and opportunities arising out of digital transformations. He is particularly focused on the intersection of industries leading to new service opportunities, the evolution of value chains becoming more customer-centric and operating in networked ecosystems, and the impact of emerging technologies on shaping business models and operating models, enabling differentiation and driving competitive advantages.

name: Sridhar CV
designation: Head, Alliances, Incubation, Research and Innovation, TCS
bio: Sridhar CV heads alliances and ecosystem partnerships for the incubation team for QC. He has over 21 years of experience in the areas of financial services and payments, governments solutions, transportation and telecom networks, and delivering multi-million-dollar technology transformation initiatives. Sridhar brings a blend of business and technology skills in the areas of QC, AI, ML, drones, robotics, and embedded systems to accelerate innovation with the help of technology leaders, startups, and other ecosystem partners. He represents TCS on BIS LITD 27 sub-committee for Internet of Things (IoT) standards. Sridhar has a bachelor's in electronics and communication engineering from JNTU Hyderabad and holds an ExPGP in strategic management from IIM Indore.

name: Sri Harsha Nistala
designation: Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Sri Harsha is a scientist at TCS Research in the areas of process modeling and simulation, optimization, industrial analytics, and digital twins. Sri Harsha led the team that won the first place in the US PHM 2018 Data Challenge.

name: Srikanth Reddy Tanigundala
designation: Domain and Functional Consultant, Solution Architect, Hospitality, TCS
bio: He is a Solution Architect and Innovation Evangelist. He has worked extensively with leading hospitality customers for over a decade, driving transformation, growth, and innovation for reservations, corporate sales, and revenue management products.

name: Srinivasa Kumar Yerchuru
designation: Head, Industry Advisory Group, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Srinivasa Kumar Yerchuru is Vice President and Global Head of the Industry Advisory Group in TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. With over 30 years of experience in spearheading large strategic programs across the financial services domain, Srini advises CXOs of global financial services organizations on current industry themes, regulations, and digital transformation. He leads thought leadership initiatives and is responsible for defining strategy and developing new offerings for financial services customers. Yerchuru holds a Master's degree in Engineering from the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore, India.

name: Srinivasa Raghavan Venkatachari
designation: Head, Digital Citizen Program, Research and Innovation, TCS
bio: Srinivasa Raghavan Venkatachari is the CTO of TCS' North America life sciences portfolio. He is responsible for driving research and innovation within the unit and engaging with the customers to innovate at scale. He has over two decades of experience in the industry, and more than a decade of experience in research and innovation. He holds a Bachelor’s degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi, India, and a Master’s degree from the Indian Institute of Technology, Madras, India.

name: Srinivasa Rao Chalamala
designation: Senior scientist, TCS
bio: Srinivasa is a senior scientist leading a trustworthy AI project under cybersecurity and privacy research at TCS. For the past four years, he has been working on understanding and evaluating security and privacy of deep-learning solutions and other trust aspects such as explainability, fairness, and bias in AI.

name: Sriram Kannan
designation: Senior Business Consultant, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Sriram Kannan is the planning and procurement lead with the innovation and transformation Group for TCS’ manufacturing business unit. He works with manufacturing customers in the UK and European markets. Sriram has over 16 years of experience in the planning and procurement function in automotive, IT hardware, consumer goods, textiles, and petrochemicals industries. He is a production engineer from the Madras Institute of Technology (MIT), Chennai, India and holds a post-graduate degree in supply chain management from SP Jain School of Global Management, Mumbai, India.

name: Srivathsan Karanai Margan
designation: Domain Consultant, BFSI Research and Innovation, TCS
bio: Srivathsan is a Domain Consultant in life insurance and pensions with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 25 years of experience across core insurance and information technology. A life insurance and pensions expert, Srivathsan is passionate about exploring and writing on how technology-led innovations impact the insurance industry.

name: Srivatsan Sridharan
designation: Head of the XR solutions segment, Research and Innovation Group, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Srivatsan Sridharan heads the XR Solutions segment in the Research & Innovation group for Manufacturing and Utilities at TCS. He provides global manufacturing customers XR and innovative technology solutions for business growth and transformation. With over 21 years of experience in the IT industry, he has worked across areas such as technology consulting, technology practice management, and global delivery. He holds a bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from the University of Madras, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India.

name: Stuart Gilchrist
bio: Stuart Gilchrist, a global managing director with TCS’ Healthcare business, leads consulting and service integration for the unit. He is responsible for driving strategic initiatives for health and wellness ecosystems to ensure accessible and affordable healthcare by leveraging technology.

name: Subasree Sampath
designation: Domain Consultant, BFSI, TCS
bio: Subasree Sampath is a domain consultant with TCS Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) unit. She has over 17 years of experience across core insurance and information technology. Subasree holds a master’s degree in Life Sciences, from the University of Madras, Chennai, India. She is a Fellow of the Insurance Institute of India and Associate of Personal Insurance from The Institutes, USA.

name: Subhadip Mahalanabish
designation: Researcher, Utilities Corporate Marketing Research Group, TCS
bio: Subhadip Mahalanabish is a Researcher for the utilities sector in the Corporate Marketing Research group at TCS. He has over 11 years of business and technology research experience in the utilities industry, spanning across global markets. Subhadip supports the business and domain teams in the utilities business unit with research on various growth and transformation initiatives.

name: Subha Veluchamy
designation: Domain Consultant, Asia-Pacific, Insurance
bio: Subha is an insurance domain consultant, part of New Growth Markets business unit focusing on Asia-Pacific. She works closely with the TCS Industry Advisory Group to serve business growth. She has over 18 years of experience in IT consulting, advisory, and has worked with several of TCS’ insurance customers around the world. Her areas of focus include new business and underwriting excellence, speed to market, product development, business process re-engineering, and core system transformation.

name: Subodh Joshi
bio: Subodh Joshi is a Senior Consultant with the Manufacturing Operations Management group of TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He leads a manufacturing excellence consulting group, part of the Europe manufacturing business group. Over 30 years, he has helped digitally transform the plant operations of discrete and process industry customers globally. In his previous role, has was the manufacturing plant operations lead for 16 years. Subodh is a six-sigma black belt and holds a Bachelor’s degree in Product Engineering from Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj University, Kolhapur, India.

name: Subramanian Bala
designation: Global Practice Head and CTO, Consumer Goods and Distribution, TCS
bio: As the CTO of TCS’ Consumer Goods and Distribution unit, Subramanian Bala leads its innovation agenda to drive new business models and propositions to customers. He is responsible for IP creation and product management for the unit’s offerings, research and innovation initiatives with focus on emerging technologies disrupting the industry and incubating them. He drives industry offerings and development of platforms across the value chain to enable business model transformation by leveraging ecosystems for CPG and distribution customers and propel non-linear growth. Subbu also drives branding and positioning initiatives for the unit by defining the brand architecture, creating and publishing points of view (PoVs) on the latest trends, and enriching the TCS CPG brand by positioning the unit’s capabilities strongly through analyst interactions. He also promotes and practices thought leadership by being an active member on various panels such as the MIT Technology Review Global Panel, contributing to research initiatives in a wide range of technology areas such as AI, cloud, robotics, IoT, and 5G and their impact on evolving industry landscape. He is also a member of ‘AI Parivartaks’–a voluntary initiative at NASSCOM to help India realize its AI goals.

name: Subramanian Kuppuswami
designation: Global Head, Sustainable Banking and Investments, BFSI, TCS
bio: Subramanian Kuppuswami (Subi) is the global head of Sustainable Banking and Investments in the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit at TCS. Subi has over 25 years of sales, solution development, and technology experience in banking and financial services. With a passion for sustainability, Subi enjoys working at the intersection of sustainability and ESG, business and technology, championing TCS’ efforts in externalizing its sustainability capabilities and crafting differentiated solutions to address the rapidly emerging needs in this space. Prior to this, Subi was responsible for leading large sales opportunities for multiple TCS clients across Europe and the UK. Subi holds a bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering and is a sports enthusiast who loves playing cricket, badminton, squash, and enjoys coaching young kids in cricket.

name: Suchithran Padikkal
designation: Regional Head – Cognitive Business Operations, MEA & APAC, TCS
bio: Suchithran, who has been with TCS for over 25 years, leads the Cognitive Business Operations unit for Middle East and Africa and the Asia Pacific region. In TCS, he has held various leadership roles across geography sales, delivery and solution units. Suchithran has helped formulate growth and transformation strategies for various customers across multiple industry verticals leveraging three key themes — customer experience, data analysis & insights and GBS simplification. Being a champion of Diversity and Inclusion, Suchithran played a crucial role in setting up TCS’ All Women Global Delivery Center at Riyadh, KSA. Under his leadership, today TCS has over 900 women associates providing IT and IT enabled services for its various customers from this unique center. Suchithran is a postgraduate in engineering from the prestigious Indian Institute of Technology (Madras) and is recognized as a Tata Group Emerging Leader. He is a certified Tata Business Excellence Model assessor and Six Sigma Champion.

name: Suchithran Padikkal
designation: Regional Head – Cognitive Business Operations, MEA & APAC, TCS
bio: Suchithran, who has been with TCS for over 25 years, leads the Cognitive Business Operations unit for Middle East and Africa and the Asia Pacific region. In TCS, he has held various leadership roles across geography sales, delivery and solution units. Suchithran has helped formulate growth and transformation strategies for various customers across multiple industry verticals leveraging three key themes — customer experience, data analysis & insights and GBS simplification. Being a champion of Diversity and Inclusion, Suchithran played a crucial role in setting up TCS’ All Women Global Delivery Center at Riyadh, KSA. Under his leadership, today TCS has over 900 women associates providing IT and IT enabled services for its various customers from this unique center. Suchithran is a postgraduate in engineering from the prestigious Indian Institute of Technology (Madras) and is recognized as a Tata Group Emerging Leader. He is a certified Tata Business Excellence Model assessor and Six Sigma Champion.

name: Sudeshna Choudhury
designation: Consulting Partner, TCS
bio: Sudeshna Choudhury is a consulting partner in sustainable innovation for the life sciences and healthcare, energy, resources, and utilities business of TCS. She has over 24 years of experience with a focus on data, analytics, and sustainability, working for customers across industry verticals. She is very passionate about circularity solutions specifically focused on waste to resource transition. She is keen on networking and collaborating across industries and academic institutions, promoting and creating an ecosystem of sustainable innovation. She was the IEEE India Council Vice Chair for Women in Engineering in 2023-24. She was the founder Chair for Women in Data in the Asia region.

name: Sudheer Warrier
designation: Global Head, Utilities Business Unit, TCS
bio: Sudheer Warrier is Vice President and Global Head of Utilities at TCS. He has 30 years of experience with a proven track record as a leader in setting up and scaling global businesses. In his current role as the P&L head of utilities, Sudheer has steered the expansion of the business globally, partnered with key customers in their digital transformation journeys, and thereby established a leadership position for TCS acknowledged by leading industry analysts. Through his career, Sudheer has played a pivotal role in leveraging research and innovation as part of his strategy to differentiate and create value for customers. He has extensive experience across the value chain covering architecture, delivery, sales, technology, and P&L management. He has designed and structured various learning and development programs. Sudheer is passionate about diversity and inclusion and has built strong, integrated global teams.

name: Sudip Kar
designation: Senior Manager, Life Sciences, TCS
bio: Sudip Kar has over 17 years of experience in the pharmaceutical and life sciences industry. He has also worked with manufacturing companies and has rich experience in regulation and quality domains. Sudip has managed regulatory submissions for mergers and acquisitions for pharmaceutical companies and participated in various regulatory submissions and regulatory compliance activities across the globe. He has a master’s degree in pharmacy from JSS College of Pharmacy in Karnataka, India.

name: Suhas J
bio: Suhas J is a Managing Partner with the Enterprise Transformation group within TCS’ HiTech business unit. He works on next-generation digital transformation engagements and has been part of several strategic solutions consulting and implementation projects for TCS’ global clients. He holds a bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Computer Science) from BMSCE, Bengaluru, India and a post-graduate degree in management (strategy and information systems) from Católica Lisbon School of Business and Economics, Europe. He has also completed an executive education program on ‘Strategy in the Digital Era’ from the Indian School of Business, Hyderabad, India.

name: Sujata Dasgupta
designation: Global Head, Financial Crime Compliance, Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance, TCS
bio: Sujata Dasgupta is a domain consultant and subject matter expert in AML and Regulatory Compliance in BFS, with over 16 years of experience in banking, IT services and consulting. She has worked with premier international Banks, in some of the major financial hubs globally, like New York, London, Singapore, Hong Kong SAR and Frankfurt, on large regulatory transformation programs, leading domain teams on KYC/CDD, AML and Regulatory Reporting engagements. She is a Cost & Management Accountant (ICWA) and also a Certified Associate of the Indian Institute of Banking & Finance (CAIIB).

name: Sujatha Gopal
designation: CTO, Communications, Media & Information Services
bio: Sujatha Gopal is the chief technology officer (CTO) of the Communications, Media, and Information Services business unit of Tata Consultancy Services. A seasoned professional, Sujatha has over 25 years of diverse work experience across various industries including telecommunications, banking and financial services, manufacturing, retail, and media. Her work is vital in driving initiatives like creation of digital ecosystems and marketplaces, fostering autonomous networks, enabling next-gen software engineering, and sustainability solutions.

name: Sukhdev Balaji
designation: Head, 3D Printing Solutions
bio: Sukhdev Balaji heads the 3D Printing Solutions, Next Gen Design to Manufacturing CoE within the Engineering and Industrial Services (EIS) business unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He has over 22 years of experience in engineering design and development, and his areas of expertise include plastics product engineering, product packaging and green engineering. Balaji has a Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering from NTTF and is a certified PMP with the Project Management Institute, USA.

name: Suman Mondal
designation: Domain Consultant - Upstream Oil and Gas
bio: Suman is a Geoscientist with over 14 years of experience in upstream oil and gas. He has a perfect blend of field experience and technological expertise and is currently working with TCS as a Domain Consultant. Suman has rich experience in consultancy projects, specifically subsurface data management and workflow integration. He has also conceptualized and developed digital solutions for the upstream oil and gas industry.

name: Sumedh Waikar
designation: Business & Technology Services, TCS
bio: Sumedh Waikar is part of Business and Technology Services in TCS.

name: Sumit Kumar
bio: Sumit Kumar is an engagement manager with TCS’ HiTech business unit. Currently, he manages delivery and client relationships for key account portfolios for the HiTech business unit. He is a certified project management professional (PMP®) and has a proven track record in project management. He has around 16 years of IT experience, having begun his career as an SAP consultant for several of TCS’ customers. He has also been recognized as a Contextual Master and is professionally active at the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE), UP chapter. He has presented multiple papers at industry conferences and written articles on various emerging technologies.

name: Sunder Singh
designation: Global head, Oracle Practice
bio: Sunder Singh is an ex TCSer and used to head the Global Oracle Practice at Tata Consultancy Services where he lead global teams that design, implement and optimize Oracle solutions to bring new innovations to TCS clients. With more than 25 years of IT experience including programming, system analysis, and large program management, Sunder held management positions across many geographies and industry verticals, including banking, manufacturing, insurance, and print publishing and information services.

name: Dr. Sunil Bandi
bio: Dr. Sunil Bandi is an SME for telemedicine and digital health and works for TCS ADD life sciences platforms. In his expansive career spanning 17 years, Dr. Sunil practiced medicine and contributed toward digital teaching solutions for healthcare professionals, telehealth, and digital transformations. His interests include virtual medicine, remote patient care management, digital technology for effective interventions for patients, and virtual clinical trials.

name: Sunil Koul
designation: Head - Product Engineering & Innovation, TCS Platform Solutions
bio: Sunil heads the Product Engineering & Innovation for TCS' source-to-pay Platform TAP™. With 30+ years of experience, Sunil has led engagements for clients in industry verticals such as CPG, Manufacturing, and Media covering design, transformation, and delivery across areas such as source-to-pay processes, and sourcing strategy creation and implementation. Sunil has played various roles related to managing large transformation, product development, and presales initiatives.

name: Sunita Danda
bio: Sunita Danda is a product specialist, currently working on TCS MasterCraft TM TransformPlus, a suite of products and solutions which help businesses in automated modernization and rapid application development. She has over 26 years of work experience and is currently focused on legacy modernization and digital application development engagements using model-driven development (MDD) techniques, automated code generation, and low-code drivers. She has completed her Masters in Computer Science from Andhra University.

name: Ms. Sunita Mishra
bio: Sunita leads Pre-sales and Solutions for TCS MasterCraft™ TransformPlus, a suite of products and solutions which help businesses in automated modernization and rapid application development. She has over 16 years of work experience and is currently focused on legacy modernization and digital application development engagements using model- driven development (MDD)techniques, automated code generation, and low-code drivers. She has completed Bachelor of Engineering in Computer Science and Engineering from University College of Engineering, Burla.

name: Supratim Ghosh
designation: Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Supratim Ghosh is a Scientist at TCS Research. He works in the area of supply chain, robotics, networked control, and optimization. Supratim holds a doctorate and a master’s degree in Electrical Engineering and Mathematics from Pennsylvania State University. He also has a B. Tech from the National Institute of Technology, Jalandhar, India.

name: Supratim Majumdar
designation: Lead Research Advisory, TCS
bio: Supratim Majumdar works for Marketing and Research Advisory, TCS, and is focused on studying the continuous evolution of enterprises and industry through technology adoption and innovation.

name: Surabhi Dey
designation: Research Analyst, Corporate Marketing Research and Advisory, TCS
bio: As a senior research analyst in Corporate Marketing Research and Advisory team at TCS, Surabhi Dey aids the growth and transformation of retail, CPG, and travel and logistics businesses with deep insights garnered from her rigorous research. Her articles and blogs have been published in multiple external forums. She has been a part of speakerships in events, mentoring, interviews, and leadership interaction. She was a national finalist in the Tata Imagination Challenge. An alumnus of IIM Shillong with a BTech in Information Technology from West Bengal University of Technology, Surabhi is a music enthusiast and is passionate about singing Bollywood classics. She loves reading fiction, biographies, and spirituality books, and unwinds herself by pursuing fitness regime and travelling to new places in quest of new knowledge about food and culture.

name: Suresh Aranala Krishnamurthy
designation: Domain Consultant, BFSI Research and Innovation, TCS
bio: Suresh is a Domain Consultant in life insurance and pensions with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has over 25 years of experience across core insurance and information technology. Suresh is interested in understanding emergent technologies and creating innovative solutions for the insurance industry.

name: Suresh Srinivasan
designation: Consultant, Payments practice, BFSI, TCS
bio: Suresh Srinivasan is a domain consultant with the Payments practice of TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. His current charter is to focus on consumer payments. Over 20 years in the payments domain, Suresh has been involved in several functions such as mobile banking, business analysis, mCommerce platform product development, and presales. Suresh has worked with clients across insurance, retail, telecom, healthcare, and travel and hospitality.

name: Swaminathan Sriram
bio: Swaminathan Sriram is the Technology Head for Employee Modern Applications and Modern Intranet stream in TCS’ Microsoft Digital Workplace. He helps companies drive their digital workplace transformation by providing intelligent solutions using Microsoft 365. Swaminathan has a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from the VIT University, India.

name: Swarnabha Seth
designation: Lead Solution Architect, AWS Business Unit, TCS
bio: Swarnabha Seth is a lead solution architect for cloud transformation and migration at TCS’ AWS business unit. He has more than 17 years of experience in consulting, shaping deals, and developing solutions. Swarnabha has deep techno-functional expertise in cloud transformation programs and digitalization with an in-depth knowledge of AWS’ services and offerings. He is an AWS-certified professional and has been involved in driving innovative data, internet of things (IoT), and sustainability solutions.

name: Dr Swati Murthy
designation: Practice Director – Global Sustainability Solutions, IOT and Digital Engineering, Tata Consultancy Services
bio: Dr Swati Murthy is Director for the Global Sustainability Solutions Practice within IOT and Digital Engineering at TCS. Dr Swati anchors customer-facing solutions that address sustainability challenges across the business value chain. Having spent over a decade in TCS, she believes in inspiring strategic collaboration with clients for achieving our shared global goal of net zero. She has been advising companies on energy, carbon management, responsible sourcing, and supply chain sustainability. She is an advocate of circular economy principles and has contributed to thought leadership forums such as United Nations Environment Programme.

name: Swati Saha
designation: Solution architect, Open Banking Strategic Initiative group, BFSI, TCS
bio: Swati Saha is a solution architect in the Open Banking Strategic Initiative group of the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business unit at TCS. She has over 16 years of experience in retail banking, IT, and consulting, with expertise in open banking and next-gen digital banking. Swati is an intrapreneur who designs next-gen digital propositions as part of a garage team operating as a startup within TCS. She holds a master’s degree in software engineering from Jadavpur University, Kolkata, India.

name: Swayambhu Dutta
designation: Research Analyst, Marketing Transformation – Research team, TCS
bio: Swayambhu Dutta is a senior research analyst in the energy, resources, and utilities (ERU) domain, working for the corporate research and advisory team. Swayambhu has more than 10 years of experience spanning the telecom, energy, resources, and utility industries. He is particularly focused on the oil and gas, metals and mining, and construction industries and the cloud impact on their value chains. He has participated in multiple customer advisory workshops, seminars, webinars, round tables, and symposiums across the globe.

name: Swesh S
designation: Solution architect, MBU
bio: Swesh is a seasoned solution architect with the AI.Cloud business unit at TCS. He has been with TCS for more than 15 years. During this time, he has worked with various companies across the globe, primarily on the Microsoft stack of technologies, and helped them on their digital transformation journey. Swesh is currently focused on developing and delivering GenAI and Copilot-based solutions that can accelerate business transformation. He is enthusiastic about exploring content management services, web app development, and open-source technologies.

name: Syed Sameer Bin Hilal
designation: Domain Consultant, Education Unit, TCS
bio: Syed Sameer is a seasoned technical consultant specializing in driving digital transformation in education. He has extensive experience leading consulting activities for educational institutions to realize their vision of digital transformation. Syed is passionate about innovation and delivers strategic business solutions for clients by leveraging industry best practices and innovative approaches to achieve business objectives. He has worked on large-scale digital transformation initiatives in the public services sector.

name: Tamizhisai Kirupakaran
bio: An industry lead at TCS’ Oracle CX Business, Tamizhisai has over 20 years of experience in CRM implementations. She helps identify and build strategic opportunities for customer experience for companies across all industries. She advises clients on their growth and transformation journeys, focusing on innovations and solutions across servitization, digital customer experience, customer data platforms, and more.

name: Tanu Verma
bio: Dr. Tanu Verma is a homoeopathic physician and an experienced domain consultant with over 11 years of experience in the US healthcare industry. She holds extensive expertise in consulting, solutioning, delivery, and transition for healthcare customers in both the payer and provider space, across multiple functions including claims, medical coding, analytics, clinical investigation, CDI, and more.

name: Tarun Bhardwaj
bio: Client Partner, Energy, Resources and Utilities, TCS Tarun has over two decades of global sales and delivery experience and has led various programs for customers from the US, the UK, and ANZ regions. As a client partner, he has been responsible for implementing multiple large-scale and complex digital transformation initiatives for TCS’ engineering, procurement, and construction and oil and gas customers. He has played the role of an advisor to CXOs and leadership teams to help advise and shape their digital agendas.

name: Tarun Goswami
designation: Head, Product Engineering of Network Operations, TCS HOBS™
bio: Tarun heads the product engineering of network operations platform within TCS HOBS. He is responsible for drawing solution roadmaps and the architecture and design of products and solutions for telco operations. His areas of expertise include network assurance, service and network orchestration, and IoT device management. Tarun has a Master of Engineering degree in Software Systems from BITS, Pilani, India. He is also a PSM-certified Agile coach.

name: Tejan Balakrishnan
designation: Consulting Partner – Innovation & Technology
bio: Tejan Balakrishnan is a consulting partner, innovation and technology for a large conglomerate and diversified industries business unit. He has 19 years of experience in technology, business, and innovation, and in working with customers across Europe, the UK, and the US. Currently, he is working closely with customers in the manufacturing and financial services industries to reimagine their business solutions using digital technologies, design thinking, and co-innovation ecosystems.

name: Tim Flannery
designation: Senior Advisor, Consulting, TCS
bio: Tim Flannery is an Engagement Manager at TCS, where he brings a broad, integrated perspective to cybersecurity issues from his extensive background in government and non-profit work.​ He places a special emphasis on helping clients manage uncertainty and improve resiliency ​from the ever-expanding range of cyber threats, technology challenges, and the evolving data regulatory environment.

name: Tim Florendo
designation: Business Consultant, TCS
bio: Tim Florendo is a Senior Manager with over 16 years of experience in Operations Management, Consulting, Operational Excellence, Risk Management, Data Modeling, and Product Development. In his stint as lead for Delivery Excellence Group, Tim’s advocacy was ‘to make work easy’ by introducing innovative digitization concepts and new ways of working. He continues to carry on this mission in his role as workforce analytics consultant as he helps organizations make sense of their people data. Tim is a Tata Business Excellence Group Gold-certified DATOM Assessor, a TCS Gold-certified mentor, Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, and a certified Anaplan Level 2 Data Model Builder.

name: TK Subramanian
bio: TK has over 25 years of experience helping Fortune 500 companies drive supply chain transformation, and is a Director in the Consulting and Systems Integration Practice at Tata Consultancy Service (TCS). He has advised a number of companies in consumer, life sciences, high tech, and utilities industries on supply chain strategy and enterprise transformation programs, with focus on the roadmap for business process transformation and standardization of business processes with measured business benefits. He has an MBA in Operations Management (Georgia State University, Atlanta), MS in Project Engineering and BS in Chemical Engineering (BITS, Pilani, India).

name: Tom Franklin
designation: Director, Upstream Center of Excellence, TCS
bio: Tom Franklin is an Industry Advisor and Director of the TCS Energy & Resources Center of Excellence for Business Performance. He comes to TCS with over 40 years of Oil & Gas industry experience in operations and business unit management. For the last few years, he has worked with Energy & Resources Oil & Gas customers in the area of Digital Transformation. His main area of focus has been Advanced Digital Analytics for operations safety and performance improvement. He is one of the leaders of the implementation of TCS’ Industry 4.0 approach for the Energy & Resources unit and its Oil & Gas customers.

name: Tushar Gadge
designation: SME, Clinical Data Management
bio: Tushar Gadge is a Subject Matter Expert for Clinical Data Management at TCS. In his expansive career spanning over 11 years, Tushar has worked as a Clinical Research Associate, Subject Matter Expert, Clinical Business Analyst and Clinical Data Manager. A Six Sigma Green Belt -certified professional, his interest revolves around automation and implementation of data science technologies in the clinical research domain.

name: Uew Braun
designation: Product Manager
bio: Uwe Braun is Senior Business Development Manager for Medication Adherence Monitoring Solutions at Schreiner MediPharm, a business unit of Schreiner Group GmbH & Co. KG. Schreiner MediPharm develops and produces innovative, multi-functional specialty labels with value-added benefits for the pharmaceutical industry. Uwe is in charge of the business development for digital solutions with smart packages. He has been with Schreiner Group since 1993, holding several positions in Sales, Product Management and Business Development for the pharmaceutical as well as automotive industry. He holds a degree in Printing Technology from the University of Applied Sciences Munich.

name: Unnati Kohli
designation: System engineer, CMI
bio: Unnati Kohli is a data analyst with TCS' Communications, Media and Information Services (CMI) business unit. She works with TCS’ customers to design solutions using artificial intelligence, machine learning and analytics technologies to improve their network operations strategy and resolve business challenges.

name: Urs Meier
designation: Solution Architect, TCS Financial Solution (TCS BaNCS)
bio: Urs Meier has 37 years of experience in banking solutions across payments, core banking, and security trading, in various roles including, developer, project manager, SME, and product management and solution architect for the Switzerland and EU markets. He has been working with TCS BaNCS in product management for 9 years, covering EU and especially Swiss market innovations, leading banking working groups of different topics like SWIFT GPI, CBPR+ and PSD2/Open Banking.

name: Ushasi Sengupta
designation: Senior Research Analyst, Corporate Marketing Research, TCS
bio: Ushasi Sengupta is a research analyst in TCS’ Marketing Transformation and Operations group. In her present role, she explores new business opportunities and technology trends across the banking, financial services and insurance sector. Ushasi, a certified Supply Chain Analyst, is an Electronics and Communication Engineer from West Bengal University of Technology, Kolkata, India, and holds an MBA in General Management from XLRI, Jamshedpur, India.

name: Vandana Kadian
designation: Client Partner, Energy, Resources, and Utilities
bio: Vandana has two decades-long global sales and delivery experience in leading strategic relationships with a portfolio of clients in the IT services and outsourcing landscape. As a client partner, she has driven digital transformation initiatives for TCS’ Engineering, Procurement, and Construction customers. She has led overall relationship with P&L responsibility for the account and end-to-end portfolio of services, demonstrating value in solving IT and business problems and shaping digital agendas.

name: Vandita Tripathi
designation: Portfolio Head, Digital Data Acquisition & Decentralized Trials, TCS ADD™
bio: With over two decades of experience with TCS, Vandita possesses deep domain and technical expertise. She is currently leading multiple initiatives pertaining to product strategy, growth, and delivery of innovative platform solutions by leveraging next-gen digital technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI) / machine learning (ML) by using TCS IP. She has led the successful development and implementation of intuitive technology solutions in clinical trials, including Electronic Data Capture (EDC), decentralized trials, electronic Patient-Reported Outcomes (e-PRO), and site feasibility surveys for top global pharma organizations across multiple geographies.

name: Varada Hasyagar
designation: Head, Cloud infrastructure
bio: Varada Hasyagar is the Head-Delivery Excellence, Risk and Compliance, with over 30 years of experience in IT. He has worked across business verticals and infrastructure services with a focus on the delivery of large and complex deals involving application development, application maintenance, infrastructure services, and BPO. In his current role, Varada leads delivery excellence functions and risk management functions for cloud functions to ensure timely certifications, security operations, and smooth customer operations.

name: Varad Govindarajan
designation: Head – Industry Excellence Group, Europe Manufacturing
bio: Varad has more than over 20 years of experience in business consulting, digital enablement, and program management. His areas of specialization include artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and digital supply chain management. He has delivered strategic programs across the manufacturing value chain in areas such as order management, inventory management, scheduling and sequencing, material requirements planning, supplier relationship management, warranty, and logistics. He holds a bachelor’s degree in engineering from Bharathidasan University, Tiruchirappalli, Tamil Nadu, India.

name: Varadharajan S
designation: Product Manager, Jile & TCS MasterCraft DevPlus
bio: Varadharajan S has over two decades of experience in key leadership roles in customer engagement, delivery management, presales, and solutions for the TCS Telecom domain. He has been involved in TCS Tools Group (TTG) and TCS MasterCraft for the last ten years. He has managed TTG technology products and solutions, namely user activity integrator and cross-enterprise collaboration positioned for various accounts within the TCS cognitive business operations (CBO) business unit. He also worked as a scrum manager for TCS MasterCraft DevPlus. In addition to this, he handled organizational unit (OU) enablement roles. He positioned Jile and TCS MasterCraft products for multiple TCS customers and won business deals by building relationships.

name: Varsha Makharia
bio: Varsha is the Domain Head, Travel, Transportation and Hospitality, TCS. She has 21 years of experience in the IT services industry, out of which 18 years have been with TCS. Her experience includes roles across car rental, hospitality, and logistics domains. Varsha is regularly called upon to present at webinars, innovation events and hackathons.

name: Ved Sen
designation: Digital Evangelist, TCS, UK
bio: Ved Sen is a Digital Evangelist for TCS UK and has over 20 years of experience across emerging technology, design, and business. He has been working with and advising senior clients across retail, utilities, travel, and other industries. Currently, his work spans conversational systems, connected homes and environments, the Internet of Things, and artificial intelligence, all with the view to drive incubation models for TCS’ clients. He also runs a local proof-of-concept team in London.

name: Vedvyas Krishnamoorthy
designation: Business Development Manager
bio: Vedvyas Krishnamoorthy is a Business Development Manager in the Technology Business Unit of TCS responsible for engineering sales for customers in the semiconductor, networking, and electronic systems and platforms segments. Ved is an Electronics & Communications engineer with rich experience in networking, test and measurement equipment, and embedded systems.

name: Venkataramana Runkana
bio: Venkataramana Runkana is a chief scientist with TCS Research and leads the research program for Manufacturing and Engineering domains. He has nearly 30 years of experience in process modelling, simulation and optimization, industrial analytics and digital twins, process development, scale-up and design, and nanomaterials. A chemical engineer by education, Venkat holds a PhD in Earth and Environmental Engineering from Columbia University, New York, USA.

name: Dr Venkata Sudheendra Buddhiraju
designation: Senior Scientist, TCS Research
bio: Dr Buddhiraju is a senior scientist at TCS Research. He holds a PhD in chemical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Kanpur, India. His research interests include continuous biopharma manufacturing, energy storage devices, computational fluid dynamics and discrete element modeling, functional nanomaterials, and modeling of nanoparticle formation and growth.

name: Venkatesh Patil
bio: Venkatesh Patil heads the Engineering and Industry Solutions (EIS) group for Energy, Utilities, Resources and Government domains. He has done Masters in Engineering and has 25+ years of rich experience in IT. He has been supporting global customers of TCS to improve and optimize their operations in the areas such as plant solutions, asset management, control systems, and plant information management.

name: Venkat Seshadri
designation: Head, BFSI
bio: Venkat Seshadri heads Insurance Research and Innovation for TCS’ Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) business unit. He has 23 years of experience across core transformation, consulting, solution development, and innovation in the insurance industry. In his current role, he focuses on new technologies with the capabilities to re-imagine insurance products, processes, and customer experience. Venkat holds a Bachelor’s degree in Engineering from College of Engineering, Guindy, Anna University, Chennai, India.

name: Vidula Joshi
designation: Project Manager and Techno-Functional Consultant, TCS Energy & Resources
bio: Vidula Joshi is working as a Project Manager for Rolling and Finishing area in one of the global steel major’s large transformation program, ‘Smart Steel factory’. She is a Power Electronic Engineer with 16+ years of rich experience in Instrumentation & Process Control, MES and Business Intelligence.

name: Vidyut Navelkar
designation: Head, Quantum Computing, Strategy and Consulting
bio: Vidyut heads Quantum Computing – Strategy and Consulting at TCS and is responsible for incubating quantum computing as a potential big-bet business for TCS. In his career spanning over 30 years, Vidyut has played multiple roles in the intrapreneurship, innovation, learning and development, and software development areas, where he has been responsible for leading a variety of functions, programs, and projects. He has also been an active participant in various industry and academic forums. A senior member of IEEE and a life member of the Computer Society of India, Vidyut holds M.S. degrees in Computer Science, and Industrial and Management Systems Engineering.

name: Vigneswaran R
designation: Senior scientist, TCS Research
bio: Vigneswaran is a senior scientist and has been working with TCS Research over the last 19 years. He leads the Blockchain research efforts within the Corporate Technology Office (CTO) at TCS. His research work includes cybersecurity, network routing, and blockchain and digital identities.

name: Vijaya Saradhi Badipatla
designation: Head – Pre-sales
bio: Vijaya Saradhi Badipatla leads the pre-sales function for TCS’ Public Services business in the Europe, UK&I, and ANZ markets. In his three-decade-long experience of working across India, the US, Europe, the Middle East, and Japan, he has held several leadership and consulting roles for TCS’ customers in the public, private and non-profit sectors. He strongly believes in the urgent need to bring about a much more sustainable and equitable world. He keenly studies global events and trends across science, health, politics, economics, climate, and business

name: Vikas Agarwal
designation: Senior Consultant, Network Solutions and Services
bio: Vikas is a senior consultant with TCS Network Solution & Services unit. He has over 24 years of experience spanning multiple roles in the telecom industry. He has worked across wireless, wireline, and enterprise telecom services. His interest area has been leveraging data engineering and advanced analytics to deliver the best value to Telcos and their end customers with optimum efforts and cost. He works extensively with telecom clients across the globe, helping them improve their efficiencies with the use of data and technology. Vikas holds a degree in Industrial Engineering with a post-graduation in business administration.

name: Vikas Gopal
designation: Global Managing Partner , CFO & GBS Advisory
bio: Vikas Gopal is the Global Managing Partner, CFO & GBS Advisory within Tata Consultancy Services. He has extensive experience advising CFO's and GBS Leaders on industry trends and strategies for shared services, finance, and digital transformation. He is involved with APEX Standard Board in helping shape the GBS Standards. Vikas has held senior leadership roles in corporate America and consulting and has led the strategy, design, and implementation of several transformative programs.

name: Vimal Mangeshkar
bio: Vimal Mangeshkar is a Business Analyst and a team member with the Innovation and Product Engineering - Analytics (IPE - Analytics) group within TCS Platform Solutions. He possesses proficiency in business analytics, business intelligence and functional knowledge in HRM and operations and supply chain management. As a business analyst, he is responsible for the implementation of several predictive and embedded analytics in the home grown HRMS platform of TCS Platform Solutions. He holds a PGDM degree in Marketing and Operations Management from SDM Institute of Management Development, Mysore, and a bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering from Goa University.

name: Vinayak Bakshi
designation: Enterprise Information Architect for Data and Analytics, Manufacturing, TCS
bio: Vinayak Bakshi is an enterprise information architect for data and analytics in TCS’ Manufacturing business unit. He has 16 years of experience in implementing data warehousing solutions and enterprise architecture. He is a techno-functional consultant and has played multiple lead roles in several data and analytics projects across manufacturing, air traffic management, and retail domains.

name: Vinay Kumar Patri
designation: Senior Business Consultant, BFSI, TCS
bio: Vinay Kumar Patri is a senior business consultant and Industry Advisor with TCS’ Banking and Financial Services unit. He has over 15 years of experience in the insurance industry and over 14 years of IT experience in life annuity, group benefits, retirement, personal, and commercial insurance. His team leads the development of business solutions catering to the needs of customers. Additionally, he extends domain thought leadership, contributes to the rapid development of most viable products through steering design thinking workshops. He has conceptualized several solutions and received patent & copyrights for some of the niche solutions.

name: Vishal Mhatre
bio: Vishal Mhatre is an associate vice president and a domain consultant working with the Regulatory Services group within TCS' Life Sciences unit. Vishal brings in over 27 years of industry experience, and in-depth expertise in regulatory project management, product strategy development, regulatory operations, and compliance. He is currently leading the regulatory domain in TCS, and his expertise includes all aspects of business services and automation or IT transformation initiatives.

name: Vishal Pradhan
bio: Vishal Pradhan is the head of the Debt Management Portfolio, Credit Operations, TCS APAC. He has over 15 years of experience in the banking and financial services industry, with core expertise in credit provisioning and delinquency management. Vishal is a business analyst and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt certified. He has led multiple transformation projects for TCS’ BFSI clients and strengthened their business footprint.

name: Vishnu Srinivasan
designation: Lead, Transformation and Strategy, Travel, Transportation and Hospitality, TCS
bio: Vishnu Srinivasan, a Senior Business Consultant, is a part of the travel and logistics team, Americas unit, TCS. He leads strategy and transformation of critical programs. He has extensively worked with airlines, hospitality, logistics and distribution customers across the globe for two decades.

name: Viswanathan Ganapathy
designation: Enterprise Solutions Architecture Director, Healthcare Technology Excellence, TCS
bio: Viswanathan Ganapathy is part of the Technology Excellence Group (TEG) in the Healthcare Industry Solutions Unit at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS). He conceptualizes new strategic solutions and platforms for healthcare clients including payers, integrated payer-providers, specialty providers, and pharmacy benefit management companies. Ganapathy has 25 years of industry experience in technology, solutions, and consulting with a special focus on data security. He has an MBA with a specialization in Healthcare from the Yale School of Management, Yale University, New Haven.

name: Vivek Iyer
designation: Consulting Partner, BFSI, TCS
bio: Vivek Iyer is a consulting partner with TCS’ Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) business. He has around 15 years of experience with expertise in the commercial and consumer lending space and focuses on industry advisory, thought leadership, and solution conceptualization. Before joining TCS, Vivek worked with leading multinational banks in commercial lending and leading tech companies in product design and development for financial solutions.

name: Vivek Kulshreshtha
designation: Domain Consultant, Travel and Logistics, TCS
bio: Vivek Kulshreshtha has over 31 years of experience in the hospitality domain, specializing in software development, project management, and team leadership. Early in his career, he was instrumental in developing frontend applications such as property management systems (PMS), point of sale (POS) systems, and event management and business center solutions, along with account receivables software for back-office accounting. His work was successfully deployed in over 40 hotels. Vivek's expertise also extends to large-scale system integrations, notably within the Oracle ERP framework, where he managed the accounts receivable module and developed integrations between various frontend applications and back-office systems, enabling automated sale and settlement invoicing. He has also led integration teams responsible for implementing the Siebel Loyalty system. Throughout his career, Vivek has demonstrated strong leadership abilities, notably as a project lead overseeing a team of 60 members, who managed L1 and L2 tickets for around 90 hotels in India. His leadership journey culminated in the role of group lead, where he continued to drive innovation and efficiency across multiple projects.

name: Vivek Kumar
bio: Vivek Kumar heads Cloud and Digital CoE for Travel, Transport and Hospitality at TCS. He has more than 17 years of experience working with several of TCS’ travel and transportation customers. Vivek is a contextual master in digital transformation in the area of e-commerce. He has led multiple successful digital transformations in the aviation industry. A certified solutions architect with a focus on migration and modernization strategies, Vivek specializes in technology strategies and innovation.

name: V Ramakrishnan
bio: Ramakrishnan (“Ramki”) was the Chief Financial Officer of Tata Consultancy Services Ltd (TCS) from February 2017. Ramki joined TCS Finance in 1999 and served as the Finance Head of TCS North America for 7 years. He closely partnered with business in the rapid growth of TCS’ operations in the region. As CFO, he was driving financial and operational efficiency resulting in sustained industry leading margins, strong cash conversion and effective management of currency exposure and other risks. In his overall professional career of over 39 years; he worked with Tata Motors, Tata Elxsi and in the consumer electronics industry. Ramki is a graduate in commerce and an Illustrious Alumni from Loyola College, Chennai. He is a member of the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, the Institute of Company Secretaries of India and the Institute of Cost Accountants of India. He has also qualified from the Chartered Institute of Management Accountants, London. Ramki has been recognized as Best CFO – Second Place in the 2018 and Best CFO – First Place in the 2019 All Asia Executive Team surveys by Institutional Investors magazine, which polls over 2,500 investment professionals across 900 financial services’ firms. Dalal Street Investment Journal ranked Ramki as Best CFO in the Large Cap IT Sector, in August 2019. In August 2007, he was member of Performance and Talent Management Consortium at Harvard Business School. Ramki regularly participates in “Tata Business Excellence” (TBEM) as leader / mentor for external assessments of Tata Group Companies and has been recognized as “Star Assessor” for three consecutive years.

name: Yogananda Ravindranath
designation: Product Consultant, TCS MasterCraft
bio: Yogananda Ravindranath is part of the Research & Innovation unit of the Components Engineering Group (CEG), TCS MasterCraft, focusing on ML-based research in Application Reverse Engineering and Transformation. Yoga has over 15 years of experience in the Engineering and Deployment of TCS MasterCraft products and has led the deployment of the product in various large transformation engagements. His primary focus is to derive innovative solutions for legacy modernization problems and build enhanced capabilities for TCS MasterCraft.

name: Yogesh Chauhan
designation: Director of Corporate Sustainability, TCS
bio: Yogesh is the Director of Corporate Sustainability at TCS since May 2012. His brief is to develop the company's sustainability and corporate affairs operations across the UK and Ireland. He oversees a range of external engagements, diversity, environmental, innovation and thought leadership initiatives designed to embed sustainability across the company and build trust in the TCS brand. Yogesh was educated at the London School of Economics and previously worked at the BBC

name: Yugesh Avadhanula
designation: Solution Architect, TCS MasterCraft™
bio: Yugesh Avadhanula is a Solution Architect, currently working on TCS MasterCraft™ TransformPlus, which is an automated modernization and rapid application development platform that helps enterprises in their digital journey without business disruption. He has over 14 years of industry experience including Java based product development, model driven engineering, Cloud architecture and DevOps. He holds a Bachelor of Technology from Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University and a Master of Sciences from BITS Pilani.

name: Zakhir Hussain Sidickk
designation: Senior Consultant, Consumer Goods and Distribution, TCS
bio: Zakhir has more than 25 years of experience in the IT industry. He leads digital innovation for the consumer packaged goods (CPG) unit at TCS and is responsible for developing digital marketing and SAP ERP-based solutions for TCS' CPG clients.
